objective_for_doctor:
Age: 59
Sex: F
Chief Complaint: pain

turns.content: Hello, I'm your doctor today. What brings you in today?

I’m having severe pain in my chest—lower and upper chest, both right and left breast area, and epigastric—with it being sharp and very intense (9/10). It started very quickly (9/10 pace) and radiates to the posterior chest wall on the left. I’ve also been feeling significantly short of breath, with fast, irregular heartbeat/palpitations, and my symptoms are worse when lying down and better when sitting up.
[ASK] Do you have **sudden shortness of breath with pleuritic chest pain (worse when breathing in)**?
I don’t know. I do have shortness of breath or difficulty breathing in a significant way, and my chest pain is very intense and sharp, but I’m not sure if it’s worse when breathing in.
[ASK] Do you have vomiting/retching immediately before the onset of chest pain (suggesting an esophageal tear)?
[ASK] Do you have new/worsening shortness of breath with pink, frothy sputum or crackles consistent with fluid in the lungs?
I don’t know. I do have shortness of breath or difficulty breathing in a significant way.
[ASK] Do you have sudden, sharp chest pain that is worse when you take a deep breath (pleuritic pain) and/or sudden shortness of breath?
Yes. I have sudden, sharp chest pain that’s very intense (9/10) and significant shortness of breath.
